title: Comprehensive structural and DFT analysis of a newly synthesized bismuth-based organic–inorganic hybrid material: in-depth insights into vibrational, optical, and photoluminescence properties of (C8H14N2)2[Bi2Br10]·2H2O
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40439-40455
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06614J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amin Alibi, Nour Elleuch, Sergiu Shova, Jerome Lhoste, Guillaume Duval, Mohamed Boujelbene
A newly synthesized bismuth-based organic–inorganic hybrid material, (C8H14N2)2[Bi2Br10]·2H2O, was synthesized using a slow evaporation technique and thoroughly characterized to explore its structural, vibrational, optical, and electronic properties.
